description:
clippy::doc_markdown (pedantic) flags several identifiers in doc comments across lib.rs and crl.rs that should be wrapped in backticks for rustdoc rendering:

lib.rs:122 — 'KeyUsage' (in CrlSignMissing variant doc)
crl.rs:86  — 'cRLSign' (in CrlChecker Limitations section)
crl.rs:87  — 'KeyUsage' (same block)
crl.rs:335 — 'cRLSign' (in check_revocation_against_anchor doc)
crl.rs:575 — 'CRLNumber' (in crl_number() fn doc comment)
ocsp.rs:371 — 'CertID' (in HashOutput enum doc)
ocsp.rs:374 — 'CertID' (same)

Fix: wrap each identifier in backticks so rustdoc renders them as inline code.
No functional change.
title: [rusty/pkix-revocation] doc_markdown: backtick-wrap identifiers in doc comments
